cover.alt: Editorial shot of a bald model standing on a snowy ground beneath a starry night sky. She wears a sculptural dress with liquid/metallic forms in silver and teal — a digital IoDF x H&M creation — paired with strappy silver heeled sandals. Arms outstretched, head tilted up, the pose evokes a cosmic figure suspended between sky and earth.
